thread:
erin: Quick heads-up — we need to extend the launch freeze by 45m to cover the US evening traffic pattern. proposing 00:00-03:45 UTC -> extend to 04:30 UTC. @eng-oncall pls ack.
alice: ack, agree with the extension. any blockers from infra?
bob: infra OK as long as we keep canary at 5% for the additional window. will lock capacity.
carol: oncall available. i'll watch alerts and keep a tight SLO threshold. loa set to 2.
derel: (typo) dave: product +1 on extension. need release notes gating check — last approval from docs?
erin: docs said they can push a tiny patch by +20m. release-notes repo has draft. main ask: pin v2.3.7 to stable and ensure deploy-bot uses that tag.
alice: deploy plan: canary -> ramp 5->25->75 over 30m steps. if error rate >1.5% at any step, rollback to previous tag and pause.
bob: will create a pin in deploybot config: `model_service: tag: v2.3.7 pinned: true window: extended` — will push in 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: user=alice action=prepare_canary target=service/model-service tag=v2.3.7
deploy-bot: canary launched: id=canary-1766543210 status=warming pods=3 region=us-west-2
carol: seeing a minor spike in latency on canary start, investigating. baseline 120ms -> 180ms.
alice: keep an eye; if p95 > 300ms for two consecutive 5m checks we abort.
bob: infra rolled a kernel micro-tune on canary hosts; that might account for latency. reverting now.
deploy-bot: canary health poll: p50=130ms p95=140ms errors=0 deploy-id=canary-1766543210
erin: good — proceed with scheduled ramp. final checklist: 1) pin set (bob) 2) docs patch merged (erin) 3) oncall monitoring (carol) 4) rollback owner assigned (alice)
alice: rollback owner = alice. i've got playbook ready: `./deploy/rollback-playbook.md` — main steps: scale-to-zero new tag, reroute traffic, confirm baseline metrics.
dave: product will hold the go/no-go channel. ping me on thread when at 75%.
carol: alerting hooks added: `#oncall-alerts` + sms for sev1.
erin: thanks team. extending freeze window now and logging extension in change window tracker. will post final status at +40m.
alice: thanks — please add a short blurb to release notes about the extension and canary stability.
deploy-bot: canary ramp to 25% complete. status=stable metrics-ok
erin: closing loop — extension confirmed. last check in 10m and then ramp to 75% if stable. :thumbsup:
